system.description:
Your mastery of your own flesh is so complete that you dissolve into a fine, sentient cloud that not the mightiest natural wind can scatter.

Assuming Mist Form costs one Blood Trait and takes three full turns; additional Blood Traits reduce this one-for-one to a minimum of one turn at three Traits, and you may change back instantly at any time. You are immune to mundane physical attacks and automatically take one less level of damage from fire and sunlight, though mystical attacks affect you normally. You may drift at a brisk walking pace (strong winds can push you about) and slip through tiny cracks and holes, and may still use Disciplines that require no physical form (Presence, but not Dominate, for you have no eyes). You cannot affect the world physically.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
